estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 118 lines with 16 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 512 MB, CPU: 640m.

warnings.message: Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`
In POSIX sh, == in place of = is undefined.
Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`

suggestions.message: Use $(...) notation instead of legacy backticks `...`.
Use the `--no-cache` switch to avoid the need to use `--update` and remove `/var/cache/apk/*` when done installing packages
Note that A && B || C is not if-then-else. C may run when A is true.

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
